_비고: 올라가는 글의 정본. 사람이 읽는 판은 ../게시글.md. 공개 글에 제작 도구 이름을 쓰지 않는다. 사람이 모두 AI 모델이고 GOYO가 가상 브랜드라는 것을 글에 적는다. 대표 프로필 영상 글.
caption:
Noise cancelling, tested at the hardest level: a Korean family dinner.

"So… any wedding plans?"
"You look thin. Eating okay?"
"I got promoted, you know."
"Seeing anyone yet?"

One tap, and the table goes quiet. Only Grandma gets through.

It's a spec ad for GOYO, an earbud brand that doesn't exist. Every person at this table is an AI model, and nothing was filmed on set.

How we made it:
– All nine shots started as stills, so the five people, the table and the light were set before anything moved.
– Every relative was directed beat by beat: when the aunt leans in, when a cousin taps his chest, when Grandma's hand reaches over.
– The earbuds and the case were modeled in 3D first, and that model was the reference in every shot they appear in.

If your product has to prove itself somewhere loud, this is how we'd show it.
